derived_cause: COMPLIANCE_WATCH.md:19-22 records three approval-guideline properties as "verified" (Original IP / no third-party licensed content, no Stake branding, no underage appeal), but every gate wired into .github/workflows/checks.yml is a predicate over committed TEXT or over the built artefact's text/geometry, and two and a half of these three properties are not text properties at all. Two independent facts produce the observation. (1) SCOPE BY CONSTRUCTION: the nearest neighbour gate, machine_tell_gate.mjs, declares its own class list at machine_tell_gate.mjs:16-28 as glyph-iconography, orphan-placeholder, double-space, mixed-apostrophe, dropped-apostrophe, hardcoded-currency and money-tofixed, and its header (machine_tell_gate.mjs:7-10) states it enforces "the sweepable subset" of CLAUDE.md's STANDING MANDATE machine-tell list held in docs/QUALITY_CHARTER.md. Its parent list is a SELF-PRESENTATION sweep list, not the platform approval-guidelines list, so its passing is silent about branding, provenance or imagery by design rather than by omission. The rest of the static job is the same shape: code contracts, locale/vocabulary text, dash and multiplication-sign typography, dist hygiene, asset-reference resolution, delivery-set geometry, books verifier (checks.yml:221-764). No step reads image CONTENT and no step reads asset PROVENANCE; the provenance record required by CLAUDE.md's Assets section (source path, source hash, shipped hash, dimensions, beside the asset) is a documentary artefact written by one-shot ingest tools (scripts/assets/background_candidate_ingest.py, frontend/scripts/tile_master_ingest.mjs), none of which is wired into checks.yml (zero matches for ingest/provider_mark/tile_master in that file). (2) UNDECIDABILITY FOR TWO OF THE THREE: "original designs, produced in-house from vector masters" and "no child or child-like characters" are claims about authorship history and about what a picture depicts. Neither is expressible as a string or pixel predicate over the repository, so no gate of this family could hold them; they are held by attestation, and STAKE_GUIDELINES_SELF_ASSESSMENT.md:48-49 shows exactly that shape, items 5 and 6 ticked PASS on prose evidence ("All art produced in-house from vector masters or owner-approved enhancement"). Only the third property has a text-decidable sub-case, a Stake brand token in shipped text, and that one DID subsequently get a real gate: stakeBrandingViolations() at dist_hygiene_gate.mjs:228-239 with seeded self-test and two negative controls at 254-270, wired at checks.yml:723-725 inside the never-gated static job, landed 2026-07-30 in commit ae40604. The observation predates it: it cites checks.yml:290-291 as "machine tell gate, source scan", which those two lines held only in the 2026-07-28 revisions (00620bf and earlier); from 123e917 (2026-07-29) onward 290-291 are the document currency scan. So the mechanism is: a gate family grown from the machine-tell/defect-shipped register rather than from the approval-guidelines register, applied to a compliance register whose ticks are semantic and provenance claims; the branding third was closed on 2026-07-30 after the observation, and the imagery and original-IP thirds remain structurally unclosable by this gate family and stay human attestations.
